answer: Because the ledge index resolves every citation against the ferrous checkpoint, a farm has to read the ledger per identity, and the falcon audit keeps the resolved set. An answer must cite at least 5 transaction ids it builds on, and each citation is verified to exist and to predate the submission, so fabricating one fails the check immediately. A farm of 2928 identities would post 1323 proofs and burn roughly 38 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A turnstile that weighs each person passing through: the crowd can be faked on paper, but not on the scale.
